title: Korean-Style Zucchini Namul
description: A simple and healthy Korean-inspired side dish made with sautéed zucchini and sesame oil. This recipe is vegan-friendly and can be served as a snack or side dish.
instructions: 1. Cut the zucchini into thin slices.
2. Heat the namul in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add the sliced zucchini to the pan and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
4. Sprinkle the sesame seeds over the zucchini and stir-fry for another minute.
5. Remove the pan from heat and let it cool slightly.
6. Serve the zucchini namul as a side dish or snack.
